pages.text: Haulers endure a lot of stress. A standard balloon can make up to $(2)8 MAX Integrity() before breaking. However, flying in bad weather is punishing: $(4)Rain$() consumes 2 uses per trip, and $(4)Storms$() consume 3. Watch out for $(8)black smoke$(); it means your hauler is near failure.
If durability hits zero mid-flight, the balloon will crash-land and become $(4)inoperable$(). To get it back in the sky, you must repair it at a $(2)Maintenance Station$().

pages.title: Step 1: Placement
pages.text: Hold the broken hauler in your hand and $(2)Right-Click$() the Maintenance Station to place it on the repair platform.

pages.title: Step 2: Diagnostics
pages.text: With an $(2)Empty Hand$(), Right-Click the station. The system will analyze the balloon and tell you the specific damage (e.g., Clogged Burner, Torn Fabric).

pages.title: Step 3: Repair
pages.text: Hold the required material ($(2)String$(), $(2)Iron$(), $(2)Wool$(), etc.) and Right-Click to fix the damage. Finally, $(2)Shift + Right-Click$() to retrieve your good-as-new hauler!
